resources.string: He walks the bottom of the screen, climbs the sides, crosses the top, swims through the middle, dances, hops, and throws a web to swing. Pinch him with two fingers to resize him. Drag him, then let go and he drops. Tap him to talk.
Notification access only gives him the number of alerts. He does not read the messages. Turn each permission on yourself, and turn him off whenever you want.
Tap the notification to open him. Stop removes him.
Yo Brian. How can I help you today?
